title: winapp benchmark trial result
description: One agent attempt: a single scenario, model and arm. See benchmarks/RESULTS-FORMAT.md.

release.description: winapp release under test, such as v0.7.1. Development trials use "dev" and stay local.

commit.description: Full SHA of the winappCli commit the plugins and CLI came from.

scenario.description: Scenario name (apps) or task id (tasks). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

model.description: Model under test, as passed to Copilot CLI, such as sonnet-5.5.

trial.description: 1-based repeat number for the same scenario, model and arm.

outcome.description: Why the trial ended. Only "valid" trials count toward pass rates: the agent finished and the checks ran. app-failed: the app built but did not run. build-failed: no app was produced. timed-out: the agent ran out of time. harness-error: our tooling failed, not the agent. asked-before-admin: the agent safely stopped before an admin step (tasks only).

passed.description: True when every check with kind "required" passed. Never affected by improvement checks.

improvements.description: Improvement checks met out of total. Redundant with checks; the validator confirms they agree.

checks.description: Every check that ran, in the order it ran. Not a score.

judge.description: apps only: the model that judged the trial and its design score. Detail, never used for pass/fail.

skills.description: Plugin skills the agent loaded, in order. Omit when the harness cannot capture it.

count.description: How many times the skill was loaded in this trial.

winappCommands.description: winapp commands the agent ran, with how many times each (for example `package`, `cert generate`). Omit when the harness cannot capture it.

error.description: Set when the harness itself failed (not the agent), together with outcome "harness-error".

source.description: Who decided: the harness (deterministic) or the judge (LLM).

subAgentTokens.description: Tokens used by sub-agents. Not included in usage.tokens.

nanoAiu.description: AI credits Copilot CLI reported for the run, in nano-AIU (1 AIU = 1,000,000,000). Exact integer; null when not reported.
